sessions.intent: First-pass v1 plan for a PLang mail server on main: identity -> address model, C# SMTP module boundary, incoming mail -> live push, retention.

before.assumptions: Design against plang main (v0.1 module system: PLang/Modules/*Module/Program.cs), not runtime2. The researcher's brief on prior art and deliverability is not in yet, so those choices stay open.
before.risk: Deliverability (fresh IP, thousands/day) can sink the send side regardless of design; the requirement says websocket but main has no server websocket.

actions.context: Reset branch architect/mail-server onto origin/main (it had no commits of its own; it sat at the runtime2 tip). Upstream unset so a push never lands on main.

Traced main: send email already routes to os/apps/Email (email.plang.io stub); push is the per-identity live stream (plang.poll), server websocket unsupported; HttpSink needs HttpContext so a background goal can't push to another identity.

v1 plan: one current address per identity (internal or linked), lazy birth, no reuse of retired addresses; C# MailModule = SMTP/MIME only (start mail server, send mail one attempt); plang owns model, inbox, outbox, retries, retention, API; new WebserverModule 'send to identity' for push. Three questions to Ingi; deliverability waits on the research brief.

after.status: v1 plan written; waiting on Ingi's answers and the research brief.
after.notes: Research brief not yet in /shared/research/. Stages tentative, not carved.
